name: SCOTUS-Law
description: SCOTUS-Law is the first dataset of U.S. Supreme Court opinions annotated with rhetorical roles at three levels of granularity: category, rhetorical function, and step. It supports Rhetorical Role Labeling (RRL) for discourse understanding in legal and related domains.
reputation: A niche but credible legal NLP benchmark, mainly cited within rhetorical role labeling and legal discourse analysis research rather than as a broad community standard.
notes: Addresses scarcity of RRL resources; includes prototype-based methods for integrating local and global context.
